e.title_en: ASF (Romania’s Financial Supervisory Authority): reports and indicators for insurance and pensions
e.title_hk: ASF（羅馬尼亞金融監管局）：保險與養老金的報告與指標
e.summary: 罗马尼亚金融监管局（保险/养老金/资本市场）：报告栏目、私人养老金收益指标页、养老金参与查询数据子域与 MTPL 查证入口
e.summary_en: Romania’s financial supervisor (insurance, pensions, capital markets): a reports section, a private-pension return-indicator page, a pension-membership data subdomain and an MTPL lookup
e.summary_hk: 羅馬尼亞金融監管局（保險/養老金/資本市場）：報告欄目、私人養老金收益指標頁、養老金參與查詢數據子域與 MTPL 查證入口
e.body:
**ASF（Autoritatea de Supraveghere Financiară，罗马尼亚金融监管局）** 是**罗马尼亚的金融监管机构**，监管范围涵盖**保险、私人养老金与资本市场**三个板块。本条目填补的是**中东欧（CEE）市场空白**——实测池内**波兰、罗马尼亚、土耳其等中东欧市场相关条目为 0**（土耳其已由本轮 [[seddk]] 补上）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 `/en/` 72.6KB；**报告栏目 `/en/a/970/rapoarte`** 76KB，另有报告列表页 `/en/c/47/reports`；**私人养老金收益/指标页 `/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori`**（"Private pension funds rentability"）63.7KB；**数据子域 `data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP`**（养老金参与查询，6KB）——⚠️ **但本次实测该查询页显示「Datorită efectuării unor lucrări de mentenanță, interogarea nu este momentan disponibilă」（因维护作业，查询暂不可用）**，即**入口在线但功能暂停**，此点如实标注；首页另实测可见 **MTPL 保单查证入口**（`aida.info.ro/polite-rca`，罗马尼亚强制车险）与**保险分销行为违规举报入口**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上中东欧这一块**——池内欧盟口径已有 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]] 等**欧盟层面**条目，但**成员国层面此前只有零星**；ASF 提供的是**成员国监管机构**视角，可与 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 一起用于**「欧盟框架 → 成员国落地」**的对照研究。**② 一个板块三合一**——ASF 同时监管**保险、私人养老金与资本市场**（罗马尼亚的「三合一」监管结构，与南非的「双峰」、土耳其的统一保险养老金监管形成有趣的**监管架构比较**，可对照 [[fsca]]、[[seddk]]、[[iais-icp]]）。**③ 私人养老金指标页有直接研究价值**——「Private pension funds rentability（私人养老金基金收益率）」这类**指标演化页**，配合其**养老金参与数据子域**，适合做**中东欧自愿性养老金（第三支柱）**的覆盖与收益分析（可对照 [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] 的澳洲基金级数据与 [[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在与页面结构**，**但未打开任何报告、未实际使用数据查询**；**②** 养老金参与查询子域**实测处于维护状态、功能暂停**（已如实写明，不作为可用入口承诺）；**③** 报告栏目与文档多为**罗马尼亚语**（英文入口存在，但**英文覆盖度未逐项核实**）；**④** MTPL 查证入口指向外部站点 `aida.info.ro`，**其归属性与服务条款未核实**；**⑤** 本站为**监管机构站点**，**不含精算工具或方法**。**核实说明**：`/en/`（72.6KB）、`/en/a/970/rapoarte`（76KB）、`/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori`（63.7KB）、`data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP`（6KB，含维护提示）均 HTTP 200 实测；`/en/c/47/reports` 与 MTPL 入口在页面内实测可见；**未打开任何报告或数据集**。
e.body_en:
**ASF (Autoritatea de Supraveghere Financiară)** is **Romania’s financial supervisory authority**, covering **insurance, private pensions and capital markets**. This entry fills a **Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) gap** — a measured search found **zero entries for Poland, Romania or other CEE markets** (Turkey having been added this round via [[seddk]]).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the site homepage `/en/` is 72.6KB; the **reports section `/en/a/970/rapoarte`** is 76KB, with a further reports listing at `/en/c/47/reports`; the **private pension return/indicator page `/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori`** ("Private pension funds rentability") is 63.7KB; and a **data subdomain `data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP`** (pension membership query, 6KB) — ⚠️ **but that query page currently displays "Datorită efectuării unor lucrări de mentenanță, interogarea nu este momentan disponibilă" (the query is temporarily unavailable due to maintenance work)**, i.e. **the entry point is online while the function is suspended**, recorded as such; the homepage also shows an **MTPL policy verification entry** (`aida.info.ro/polite-rca`, Romania’s compulsory motor insurance) and an **insurance distribution conduct complaint channel**.

For RIAA: **① it fills in Central and Eastern Europe** — at EU level the corpus already holds [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[insurance-europe]] and [[aae-ai-act-position]], but **member-state level entries were previously sparse**; ASF supplies the **member-state regulator** perspective, readable alongside [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]], [[solvency2rfr]], [[ggsolvencyii]], [[sii-equity-risk-scr]] and [[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] for "**EU framework in, member state out**" comparisons. **② Three sectors in one body** — ASF supervises **insurance, private pensions and capital markets** together (Romania’s "three-in-one" structure), which makes an interesting **supervisory-architecture comparison** against South Africa’s twin peaks ([[fsca]]) and Turkey’s unified insurance-and-pension regulator ([[seddk]]), with [[iais-icp]] as the international reference. **③ The private pension indicator page has direct research value** — an indicator-evolution page such as "Private pension funds rentability", together with the pension membership data subdomain, suits analysis of **coverage and returns in CEE voluntary pensions (third pillar)**, comparable to the Australian fund-level data in [[apra-superannuation-statistics]] and to [[retirement-planning]] and [[longevity-mortality-investor]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence and structure** but **opened no report and did not exercise the data query**; **②** the pension membership query subdomain was **measured as under maintenance, with the function suspended** (stated as such and not presented as a working entry point); **③** reports and documents are largely in **Romanian** (an English entry point exists, but **English coverage was not verified item by item**); **④** the MTPL verification entry points to an external site, `aida.info.ro`, **whose ownership and terms were not verified**; **⑤** this is a **regulator site and contains no actuarial tools or methods**. **Verification note**: `/en/` (72.6KB), `/en/a/970/rapoarte` (76KB), `/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori` (63.7KB) and `data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP` (6KB, maintenance notice) were all measured at HTTP 200; `/en/c/47/reports` and the MTPL entry were observed on the page; **no report or dataset was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**ASF（Autoritatea de Supraveghere Financiară，羅馬尼亞金融監管局）** 是**羅馬尼亞的金融監管機構**，監管**保險、私人養老金與資本市場**三個板塊。本條目填補**中東歐（CEE）市場空白**——實測池內**波蘭、羅馬尼亞等中東歐市場相關條目為 0**（土耳其已由本輪 [[seddk]] 補上）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 `/en/` 72.6KB；**報告欄目 `/en/a/970/rapoarte`** 76KB，另有報告列表頁 `/en/c/47/reports`；**私人養老金收益/指標頁 `/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori`** 63.7KB；**數據子域 `data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP`**（養老金參與查詢，6KB）——⚠️ **但本次實測該頁顯示「因維護作業，查詢暫不可用」**，即**入口在線但功能暫停**，如實標注；首頁另實測可見 **MTPL 保單查證入口**（`aida.info.ro/polite-rca`）與**保險分銷行為違規舉報入口**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上中東歐**——池內歐盟層面已有 [[eiopa-insurance-statistics]]、[[insurance-europe]]、[[aae-ai-act-position]]，但**成員國層面此前零散**；ASF 提供**成員國監管機構**視角，可與 [[solvency2rfr]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[sii-equity-risk-scr]]、[[eiopa-monthly-rfr-check]] 一起用於「**歐盟框架 → 成員國落地**」對照。**② 一個機構三合一**——ASF 同時監管**保險、私人養老金與資本市場**（羅馬尼亞「三合一」結構），與南非「雙峰」（[[fsca]]）、土耳其統一監管（[[seddk]]）形成**監管架構比較**，以 [[iais-icp]] 為國際參照。**③ 私人養老金指標頁有直接研究價值**——配合其**養老金參與數據子域**，適合做**中東歐第三支柱**的覆蓋與收益分析，可對照 [[apra-superannuation-statistics]]、[[retirement-planning]]、[[longevity-mortality-investor]]。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在與結構**，**但未打開任何報告、未實際使用查詢**；**②** 養老金參與查詢子域**實測處於維護狀態、功能暫停**；**③** 報告多為**羅馬尼亞語**（英文入口存在，**英文覆蓋度未逐項核實**）；**④** MTPL 查證入口指向外部站點 `aida.info.ro`，**歸屬與條款未核實**；**⑤** 本站為**監管機構站點，不含精算工具或方法**。**核實說明**：`/en/`、`/en/a/970/rapoarte`、`/en/a/204/evoluție-indicatori`、`data.asfromania.ro/scr/adeziuniFP` 均 HTTP 200 實測；**未打開任何報告或數據集**。
